title: The Global Engineer
description:
Restriction: Restricted to ENGR students who have committed to studying abroad.
Additional information: The first course in a three course sequence comprised of The Global Engineer (ENES314), Introduction to Engineering Leadership (ENES317), and Developing a Global Engineering Leadership Mindset (ENES315), which will fulfill the requirements of the GlobaLead Program. Students will take The Global Engineer the semester prior to their semester abroad.
